company.name: Depict
company.shortDescription: Depict enable anyone to discover and collect art that inspires them, and in connecting people with the work they love.
company.description:
Depict delivers incredibly stunning and visceral art experiences by enabling people to access and display an entirely new art medium in their own spaces. All of the art on Depict is created by artists for our platform using digital tools. The work is exclusive to Depict, curated by our in-house curatorial team, and previously unavailable elsewhere. 

It was founded in 2012 and headquartered in San Francisco, California.
